releaseNotes: v3.0.0 Studio Avatars & Biomechanical IK Engine: brand-new skinned glTF 2.0 (.glb) male & female athletes (27-bone rig with clavicles, finger/thumb/toe joints, 30k-vertex QEM-optimised meshes, baked AO), analytic 2-bone IK with pole vectors driving all 41 exercises from world-space constraints (hands locked to bars & handles, feet planted, benches fitted flush to the skinned body), per-pixel anatomical muscle map with crisp anti-aliased borders and fibre shading (Primary vermilion, Secondary indigo, Stabilizers cyan), key/fill/rim studio lighting with soft contact shadows, tight view-dependent auto-framing, and an automated biomechanics QA suite that verifies every rep frame for both sexes.
